title: DRCTL: A Disorder-Resistant Computation Translation Layer Enhancing the Lifetime and Performance of Memristive CIM Architecture
problem: Memristive CIM systems face a fundamental tradeoff: static data layouts optimize communication but limit reliability, while dynamic scheduling improves lifetime through wear-leveling but randomizes layouts and increases communication overhead. Existing CIM compilers directly map data to physical crossbars, making it difficult to support dynamic scheduling.
motivation: Memristive CIM architectures efficiently accelerate matrix operations but suffer from device wear and reliability degradation, requiring solutions that balance communication performance with extended system lifetime.
method: DRCTL introduces a computation translation layer with three components: (1) an address conversion method that updates instruction streams after dynamic scheduling without recompilation, (2) hierarchical wear-leveling (HWL) that reduces communication overhead by increasing scheduling granularity, and (3) data layout-aware selective remapping (LASR) that exploits data dependencies to maintain communication locality during dynamic scheduling.
key_novelty: A disorder-resistant translation layer that decouples dynamic scheduling for reliability from static data layout optimization, enabling dynamic scheduling while maintaining communication performance through address conversion and layout-aware remapping.
contributions: Address conversion mechanism for dynamic scheduling that enables existing compilers to support reliability optimizations without recompilation
Hierarchical wear-leveling strategy extending device lifetime by 100.3-205.9x while reducing communication overhead
Data layout-aware selective remapping reducing execution cycles 26.91% and off-chip NoC accesses 80.62% during dynamic scheduling

metrics.other: 100.3-205.9x lifetime extension vs no wear-leveling; 36.41% on-chip NoC reduction; 80.62% off-chip NoC reduction

limitations: Comparison with state-of-the-art TIWL shows slight lifetime decrease; generalization to other workload types not discussed.
primary_theme: Translation layer for memristive CIM reliability-performance co-optimization
